changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Compare offset-aware filter bounds with track timestamps stored as UTC without a timezone. Keep this independent of the database session timezone.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE filter_config SET expression = REPLACE( REPLACE(expression, 'TO_TIMESTAMP(:DATE_TIME_FROM, ''YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'')', '(CAST(:DATE_TIME_FROM AS timestamp with time zone) AT TIME ZONE ''UTC'')'), 'TO_TIMESTAMP(:DATE_TIME_TO, ''YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'')', '(CAST(:DATE_TIME_TO AS timestamp with time zone) AT TIME ZONE ''UTC'')') WHERE filter_domain = 'GPS_TRACK' AND filter_name = 'SmartBaseFilter';
